behavior: Case-insensitive native family selection; Grok text/image/reference/video, MiniMax direct and compatible relay text/image/first_last/reference, Seedance local upload then text/image/first_last/reference, Sora text and Veo long-running operation. Credentials stay on the configured provider origin; external result downloads use public-DNS-pinned unauthenticated transport. Durable owned receipt precedes polling; refresh only queries and never submits a new generation. Ambiguous post-send failures require reconciliation.
verification: 18 tests cover local HTTP routes for Grok/Sora/MiniMax direct+relay/Seedance/Veo, ordered frame uploads, receipt-before-query, GET-only refresh, reference modes, bad IDs/abort, Veo scoped operation recovery and actual JobManager uncertainty. MP4 brand/box/mdat/moov validation rejects placeholders.
limits: Synthetic MP4 fixtures establish container structure, not successful decoder playback. No live provider credential/quality verification or large remote downloads. No first_last support claimed for Grok/Sora/Veo where backend does not implement it.
